pages.title: Ancient Remnant
pages.text: $(bold)Cataclysm's Cursed Pyramid: the Ancient Remnant's sandstorm in a bottle and skull, the necklace of the desert, ancient metal, the khopesh, the Kobolediator's bones and armour, the amethyst crab, and the dungeon stone of every Cataclysm ruin.$(br2)$(thing)Ashen Age$(n), ring 9.$(br)$(thing)40 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Warrior.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Kill the Ancient Remnant$(n)$(br2)Pays 8 Focal Shards once. Counts only once this node is reachable.
